meta.parties: Hall v. Pelmadulla Valley Tea and Rubber Co., Ltd

rules.statement: A contract that is an existing enforceable contract within the meaning of section 93 of the Trusts Ordinance can be specifically enforced, even if it affects immovable property not required by law to be registered.
rules.supporting_quote: "The contract was an existing enforceable contract within the meaning of section 93 of the Trusts Ordinance and that the plaintiff was bound to hold the property for the benefit of the company to the extent necessary to give effect to the contract."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: T HE CONTRACT WAS AN EXISTING ENFORCEABLE CONTRACT WITHIN THE MEANING OF SECTION 93 OF THE TRUSTS ORDINANCE AND THAT THE PLAINTIFF WAS BOUND TO HOLD THE PROPERTY FOR THE BENEFIT OF THE COMPANY TO THE EXTENT NECESSARY TO GIVE EFFECT TO THE CONTRACT.
